author: Seung Wook
problem: Read a non-empty string of English letters. Print Yes if its first character is uppercase and all the other characters are lowercase, otherwise No.
bug_description: Operator precedence makes `or len(S) == 1` skip the uppercase check, so a single lowercase letter gets Yes.

comments.accurate: Prints Yes when the first letter is uppercase and the rest are all lowercase
comments.wrong_behavior: Prints Yes for an uppercase letter followed by lowercase ones, or for any single-letter string
comments.wrong_location: Case checks verified; check the slice S[1:], which should leave out only the first character

source.buggy_line: if C.isupper() and D.islower() or len(S) == 1:
